summary: Completes construction of a DirectX texture surface wrapper. Calls the base texture creation routine with a mipmap chain, installs the wrapper vtable off_5ADB90, maps two source surface format codes (at a2+24 and a2+28) onto internal format flags, derives a combined 'needs special handling' flag, selects per-FourCC encoder/decoder function pointers, and computes aligned surface dimensions with pitch and stride values.

operations.description: Initialize the base object with DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 0, 1).
Map source surface format code at a2+24 to internal flag at this+0x1078: 1 -> 0, 2 -> 1, anything else -> 3.
Map source surface format code at a2+28 to internal flag at this+0x107C: 1 -> 0, 2 -> 1, anything else -> 3.
Set combined format flag this+0x1074 = (this+0x1078 != 3) OR (this+0x107C != 3), signalling a non-default surface format that needs the encoder path.
FourCC case 827611204: set bytes-per-pixel this+0x1080 = 8, this+0x1088 = FileIOWrapper, this+0x1084 = KeyframeQuadInterpolationWithBitPackedSelector.
FourCC case 844388420: set bytes-per-pixel this+0x1080 = 16, this+0x1088 = DelegationWithErrorCheck, this+0x1084 = FileOpenAndValidate.
FourCC case 861165636: set bytes-per-pixel this+0x1080 = 16, this+0x1088 = QuantizationColorSpaceConversion, this+0x1084 = sub_51512C.
FourCC case 877942852: set bytes-per-pixel this+0x1080 = 16, this+0x1088 = InitProcessWrapper, this+0x1084 = sub_51588C.
FourCC case 894720068: set bytes-per-pixel this+0x1080 = 16, this+0x1088 = sub_515417, this+0x1084 = sub_5151AF.

Store source dimension/pitch reads: this+0x109C = source pitch (this+0x1040), this+0x10A0 = source depth/extra (this+0x1044), and 4-aligned origins this+0x108C = this+0x1030 & ~3, this+0x1090 = this+0x1034 & ~3.
Derive element counts from aligned deltas: this+0x10A4 = (this+0x1094 - this+0x108C) >> 2 and this+0x10A8 = (this+0x1098 - this+0x1090) >> 2, and this+0x10AC = this+0x10A0 - this+0x109C.
Zero the three working slots this+0x10B8, this+0x10BC and this+0x10C0.
